title: Parallel Prime Counter
requirements: Count primes below N using 1, 2, 4, 8, … threads (`jthread`)
Three strategies: static chunks, interleaved (thread i takes i, i+T, …), and dynamic (atomic "next chunk" counter)
Explain why static chunks are unbalanced (bigger numbers are slower)
Speedup table and a Ctrl+C-free cancel using `stop_token`
